questions.question: Which country shares the longest border with India?
questions.solution: Bangladesh shares a 4,096 km border with India, the longest among all neighbors

questions.question: Find HCF of 48 and 64
Two dice are thrown. What is probability of getting sum = 7?
What is the LCM of 12, 18, and 24?
Convert: 'I said, I am going home'
options: I said that I am going home
I said that I was going home
I said I would go home
I told I am going home
questions.answer: I said that I was going home
questions.solution:
Indirect speech: Change present to past when main verb is past
Direct: 'I am going' → Indirect: 'I was going'

questions.question: What is probability of getting head in coin toss?
questions.solution:
A coin has 2 equally likely outcomes: Head and Tail
P(Head) = 1/2 = 0.5

questions.question: A man covers 50 km in 10 hours. What is his speed in km/hr?
questions.solution: Speed = Distance/Time = 50/10 = 5 km/hr

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence:
options: He is going to school yesterday
He has gone to school yesterday
questions.solution:
Past events use Simple Past tense. 'Yesterday' is a past time indicator.
Correct: He went to school yesterday

questions.question: Convert to Passive: They built this house in 1990
options: This house has been built in 1990
This house will be built in 1990
questions.solution:
Active: They built (past) → Passive: This house was built (past)
Structure: Object + was/were + past participle + by + subject

questions.question: What is 25% of 80?
A sum becomes 4/3 of itself in 5 years at simple interest. What is rate of interest?
In which year did India become a Republic?
questions.solution: India became a Republic on January 26, 1950, when the Constitution came into effect

questions.question: Identify error: He have completed his work
questions.solution:
Subject 'He' is singular, so use 'has' not 'have'
Correct: He has completed his work

questions.question: Choose correct: Neither the teacher _____ the students are present
questions.solution:
'Neither...nor' is a correlative conjunction pair
Correct: Neither the teacher nor the students are present

questions.question: What is the capital of Gujarat?
questions.solution: Gandhinagar is the capital of Gujarat state, while Ahmedabad is the largest city

questions.question: Fill: She is good _____ Mathematics
questions.solution:
'Good at' is correct usage for skills/subjects
Correct: She is good at Mathematics

questions.question: Which is the longest river in India?
questions.solution: The Ganga is the longest river in India, approximately 2525 km

questions.question: Which is the highest mountain peak in India?
questions.solution: Kangchenjunga (8,586m) is the highest peak in India, shared with Nepal

questions.question: What is the national animal of India?
questions.solution: The Bengal Tiger is the national animal of India, representing strength and grace

questions.question: Who wrote the Indian Constitution?
questions.solution: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar chaired the drafting committee and was the main architect of the Indian Constitution

questions.question: A shopkeeper buys a shirt for Rs. 400 and sells it for Rs. 600. What is profit%?
questions.solution:
Cost Price = 400, Selling Price = 600
Profit = 600 - 400 = 200
Profit% = 200/400 × 100 = 50%

questions.question: If A's income is 20% more than B's, then B's income is what % less than A's?
questions.solution:
Let B's income = 100, A's = 120
Difference = 20, as % of A's = 20/120 × 100 = 16.67%

questions.question: How many states are there in India?
questions.solution: India has 28 states and 8 union territories (as of 2024)

questions.question: Fill: She sang _____ and danced all night
questions.solution:
Adverbs modify verbs. 'Beautifully' modifies 'sang'
Correct: She sang beautifully and danced all night

questions.question: Choose correct article: I need _____ honest person
questions.solution:
'Honest' starts with vowel sound, so use 'an'
Correct: I need an honest person

questions.question: Two items are sold at equal selling price. One at 20% profit, other at 20% loss. What is net loss%?
Choose correct: If I _____ him, I would help
questions.solution:
Conditional sentence: If + past, would + verb
Correct: If I knew him, I would help (Conditional Perfect)

questions.question: Who is the current President of India?
questions.solution: Droupadi Murmu became the 15th President of India on July 25, 2022

questions.question: Who was the first Prime Minister of India?
questions.solution: Jawaharlal Nehru was the first PM of India (1947-1964)

questions.question: Fill: She ___ been working here for 5 years
questions.solution:
Present Perfect uses 'has' with singular subject (She).
Correct: She has been working here for 5 years
